title: GL-12 — Step Functions
stopChargesPanel: Delete state machine, its CloudWatch log group, and the IAM role used by Step Functions.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on Step Functions; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Execution role
bullets: Run `$Trust = @{Version='2012-10-17';Statement=@(@{Effect='Allow';Principal=@{Service='states.amazonaws.com'};Action='sts:AssumeRole'})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress; $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl12-trust.json", $Trust, $utf8)`. This writes the Step Functions trust policy (Principal Service `states.amazonaws.com`) as UTF-8 without a BOM.

Run `aws iam create-role --role-name workbook-gl12-sfn --assume-role-policy-document file://gl12-trust.json --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-12 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt`

Run `$LogPolicy = @{Version='2012-10-17';Statement=@(@{Effect='Allow';Action=@('logs:CreateLogDelivery','logs:CreateLogStream','logs:GetLogDelivery','logs:UpdateLogDelivery','logs:DeleteLogDelivery','logs:ListLogDeliveries','logs:PutLogEvents','logs:PutResourcePolicy','logs:DescribeResourcePolicies','logs:DescribeLogGroups');Resource='*'})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress; $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl12-log-policy.json", $LogPolicy, $utf8)`. This is the AWS-documented CloudWatch Logs permission set for a Step Functions execution role.
Run `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name workbook-gl12-sfn --policy-name gl12-log --policy-document file://gl12-log-policy.json`.
Run `$SfnRoleArn = aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-gl12-sfn --query Role.Arn --output text`.
Success: role Arn is set.

steps.title: State machine
bullets: Run `$Asl = @{Comment='gl-12 minimal Standard workflow';StartAt='Hello';States=@{Hello=@{Type='Pass';Result='Hello from gl-12';Next='Done'};Done=@{Type='Succeed'}}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress; $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl12.asl.json", $Asl, $utf8)`. This saves an ASL definition with a Pass state that transitions to a Succeed state, as UTF-8 without a BOM.

Run `aws logs create-log-group --log-group-name /aws/vendedlogs/states/workbook-gl12 --tags Workbook=aws-tf-lab,LabId=gl-12,CreatedAt=$CreatedAt,ExpiresAt=$ExpiresAt`. This creates a dedicated CloudWatch Logs log group for the state machine's execution history.

Run `$LogGroupArn = aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/vendedlogs/states/workbook-gl12 --query "logGroups[0].arn" --output text`. Success: `$LogGroupArn` is set (it already ends with `:*`, which Step Functions requires).

Run `$LoggingConfig = @{ level = 'ERROR'; includeExecutionData = $true; destinations = @(@{ cloudWatchLogsLogGroup = @{ logGroupArn = $LogGroupArn } }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress; $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl12-logging-config.json", $LoggingConfig, $utf8)`. This saves the Step Functions logging configuration (ERROR level, execution data included, one CloudWatch Logs destination) as UTF-8 without a BOM.

Run `$SmArn = aws stepfunctions create-state-machine --name workbook-gl12 --definition file://gl12.asl.json --role-arn $SfnRoleArn --logging-configuration file://gl12-logging-config.json --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-12 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt --query stateMachineArn --output text`.
Success: state machine Arn is set and logging is enabled.

steps.title: Start execution
bullets: Run `$ExecArn = aws stepfunctions start-execution --state-machine-arn $SmArn --input '{}' --query executionArn --output text`.
Run `aws stepfunctions describe-execution --execution-arn $ExecArn`.
Success: status SUCCEEDED.

steps.title: List executions
bullets: Run `aws stepfunctions list-executions --state-machine-arn $SmArn --max-results 1`.
Success: your execution appears.

steps.title: Transition cost note
bullets: Standard workflows bill per state transition; this run used one Pass.
Success: you noted the estimate from the card.

steps.title: Prepare delete
bullets: Delete state machine, then the CloudWatch log group, then the IAM role policy and role.
Success: Stop charges order is clear.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Standard Workflows bill per state transition; this lab used two transitions (Pass, Succeed). CloudWatch Logs bills per-GB for log ingestion and per-GB-month for storage of the ERROR-level execution logs this lab now enables. There is no hourly charge and an idle state machine costs nothing.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: state machine, CloudWatch log group, IAM role
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-12` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources (the state machine and role) cost nothing while idle, but the CloudWatch log group can still bill for stored data if not deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-12 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-12 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-12. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Minimal Standard workflow with one successful execution.
